function.arguments: {"observation": "The analysis restricted to completed orders only, but the question implies the full dataset as the population. The question asks for conversion rates, which are defined as (converted orders) / (total orders), so refunded orders should be included in the denominator.", "implication": "The population for the conversion rate must include all orders, not just completed ones. function.name: note_finding
